description: Note taking application with markdown editor and encryption support for mobile and desktop platforms. Runs client-side and syncs through a self hosted Nextcloud instance or similar (alternative to Evernote).

promotion.reason: Approved by the owner. Qualified as offered on 2026-09-12: a real install of Joplin Server 3.7.1, with its database moved to PostgreSQL 14.24 proved it starts, opens to a first screen with a clear next step, survives a restart and a keep-data reinstall with its data and generated credentials intact, and removes everything it created. The definition comes from Runtipi's app store.

risk_notes: Creates 2 Docker containers and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Generates 1 credential of its own, keeps it beside the app's data, and reuses it if you reinstall.
Keeps its data in this app's managed folder. A keep-data uninstall leaves it; deleting data removes it permanently.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.

Joplin Server is source-available, not open source: its server package is under the Joplin Server Personal Use License, which allows personal, non-commercial use only. The Joplin apps you sync with it are AGPL-3.0.
Signs in first as admin@localhost with the password admin; change both in its settings, then connect your Joplin apps to its address.

image_pins.reason: The Runtipi definition runs PostgreSQL 14.2, built in May 2022 and missing four years of fixes, security fixes among them. 14.24 is the current patch of the same major version, so it reads the same data files and needs no migration.
